summary: Targeted frontend re-verification passed. The breadcrumb pill renders as rgba(0,0,0,0.75) with 12px/500 text. Conservative contrast calculations against the worst tested backdrop (white) pass WCAG AA: current crumb 10.409:1, Home link 8.058:1, and plain intermediate crumb 6.070:1. /industries and /case-studies loaded their light heroes with passing breadcrumbs; /services/sap-consulting loaded its dark hero with the correct trail. Home navigation, hidden-route behavior, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, and console/page-error checks also passed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested targeted breadcrumb checks passed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Computed browser styles were pill rgba(0,0,0,0.75), ring white/15, Home rgba(255,255,255,0.85), plain Services rgba(255,255,255,0.70), and current rgb(255,255,255), all at 12px/500. A 16-level-per-channel backdrop sweep found the minimum contrast on white: 8.058:1 Home, 6.070:1 plain intermediate, and 10.409:1 current. Light heroes were allowed to finish loading before visual checks. SAP trail was Home > Services > SAP Consulting; Home href and click to / passed. Breadcrumbs were absent on / and /adminia. SAP BreadcrumbList JSON-LD contained Home and SAP Consulting with positions 1 and 2. No browser console errors or page errors were observed.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior failure was resolved by increasing pill opacity from black/50 to black/75 and raising crumb text opacity. Even on a white backdrop, the pill composites to approximately rgb(63.75,63.75,63.75), keeping every required 12px text role above the 4.5:1 WCAG AA threshold.
